name: RMD-MP
savepath: This is a hotfix update for our previous patch which resolves a lot of event-related woes, along with simplifying the candy corn recipes using our new cube engine. I apologize for the delayed resolution, but hope you enjoy the new content!

D2RHUD has also received a very large update, adding many new 'hardocde' features along with improved logic, performance and UI viewability. For RMD players especially, the new quest journal, D3 whirlwind, etc will be valuable additions to your adventure...enjoy!
